constraints.definition: CHECK (((data ?& ARRAY['id'::text, 'orderId'::text, 'revision'::text, 'confirmedOn'::text, 'reference'::text, 'contact'::text, 'note'::text, 'actor'::text, 'at'::text]) AND (NOT jsonb_path_exists(data, '$.*?(@ == null)'::jsonpath)) AND ((data ->> 'id'::text) = (id)::text) AND ((data ->> 'orderId'::text) = (order_id)::text) AND (((data ->> 'revision'::text))::integer = revision) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'revision'::text)) = 'number'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'reference'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'contact'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'note'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'actor'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'reference'::text))) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'reference'::text))) <= 100)) AND ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'contact'::text))) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'contact'::text))) <= 200)) AND ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'note'::text))) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'note'::text))) <= 1000)) AND ((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'actor'::text))) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM (data ->> 'actor'::text))) <= 200)) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'confirmedOn'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND ((data ->> 'confirmedOn'::text) = to_char((((data ->> 'confirmedOn'::text))::date)::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYY-MM-DD'::text)) AND (jsonb_typeof((data -> 'at'::text)) = 'string'::text) AND (((data ->> 'at'::text))::timestamp with time zone IS NOT NULL)))
